sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, sitting top of the table with 22 points from 10 games and an impressive recent run of five consecutive wins, will look to extend their dominance when they host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00. The visitors are struggling badly at the foot of the division with just 4 points from 10 matches, having won only once recently, making this a strong opportunity for the league leaders to maintain their position.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town will be keen to stay in contention when they travel to Dawley Town on Saturday, while third-ranked AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall in a clash between two of the division's stronger sides. Wolverhampton Casuals, also among the top four, face Wednesfield Community at home. In the middle of the table, Bilston Town (6th) travel to Foley Meir, Barnton host Shawbury United, and New Mills visit Market Drayton Town—all fixtures involving teams in the mid-table region. At the bottom, Telford Town's struggles continue as they visit Cheadle Heath Nomads, while Widnes Town, with just 2 points from 7 games, travel to Brereton Social looking to improve their dire points tally. Crewe take on Allscott Heath in a fixture between two lower-table sides, and Eccleshall's visit to Bridgnorth will test whether they can climb further up the standings.
